instruction: Move the 'ReadMe' sheet tab to be the first (leftmost) sheet in the opened spreadsheet workbook.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent read reminder.docx to get sheet reordering requirements. Successfully moved ReadMe to position 1, Raw_data to position 2, and Beans to position 3. Then struggled with imprecise tab dragging coordinates for remaining sheets and ran out of 50 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open/read documents in LibreOffice Writer, navigate between sheets in LibreOffice Calc, drag sheet tabs with some imprecision, use File > Open dialogs, switch between applications
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed to complete full 10-sheet reorder due to imprecise screen coordinate targeting for tab drag-and-drop operations. Ran out of turns (50) with many sheets still misplaced.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original 10-sheet reorder into single-sheet move. Model proved it can move ReadMe to first position in the trajectory.
metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the ReadMe sheet tab to be the first sheet. Evaluator reads sheet names from the saved xlsx and checks if the first sheet is 'ReadMe'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads xlsx file via openpyxl and extracts ordered sheet names, returning the first sheet name.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter: directly accesses expected.get('expected_first_sheet') since expected IS the rules dict when type='rule'.
Postconfig properly activates the LibreOffice Calc window and saves the file with Ctrl+S before the getter reads it, ensuring fresh state.
Expected value 'ReadMe' correctly matches the instruction requirement to move 'ReadMe' to the first position.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (ReadMe as first sheet) is fully verified by the evaluator.
